description: One generation in full: parsed output data plus associated image URLs (thumbnail-first, never base64). Very large outputs are truncated to a raw JSON prefix with output_truncated: true instead of failing; check that flag before assuming the full output object is present. images and relationships are independently paged 20 per page via images_page/relationships_page (1-indexed, default 1); check images_total/relationships_total and the *_next_page fields to page through the rest.

images_page.description: 1-indexed page of the images list to return, 20 per page. Default 1.

relationships_page.description: 1-indexed page of the relationships list to return, 20 per page. Default 1.

name: chargen_get_generation
title: Get generation
